offerings.title: Revit and Dynamo automation
offerings.problem: BIM teams repeatedly rename, place, tag, schedule, inspect, and export the same information.
offerings.deliverable: customized Dynamo/Python/Revit automation routines; documented inputs/outputs; error handling; sample project acceptance tests; source/handoff notes.
offerings.evidence: EnTech/JFK Terminal One coordination; Stantec tooling; HGA CAD/Revit data workflows; repeated professional Dynamo/Grasshopper development.

offerings.title: BIM QA/QC and coordination dashboards
offerings.problem: inconsistent naming, mismatched model properties, missing requirements, costly manual checks.
offerings.deliverable: repeatable model checking procedures, issue reports, dashboards and QA checklists, with clear rules for false positives and human review.
offerings.evidence: professional coordination on 12 multidisciplinary JFK Revit models and Dynamo QA/QC. Reported outcomes in CVs require validation before publishing a numerical improvement.

offerings.title: IFC and openBIM model inspection
offerings.problem: models are trapped in authoring tools or hard to inspect across firms.
offerings.deliverable: IFC import/inspection workflow, model browser, property/quantity explorer, and structured exports.
offerings.evidence: IFC generation/export work, browser BIM explorations, IFC Tower Fragment Modeler prototype, American Superblock IFC outputs, That Open/Fragments experimentation.

offerings.title: IDS-based BIM validation tools
offerings.problem: project teams need repeatable checks against machine-readable information requirements.
offerings.deliverable: IFC/IDS rule dashboard, multi-IDS loading, per-rule pass/fail and conformance summaries, exportable issues.
offerings.evidence: September 2026 IFC Validation Webapp demo described as using OpenBIM Components/Fragments, parallel rule execution and multiple IDS files. No formal certification should be implied.

offerings.title: Model-version comparison and progress intelligence
offerings.problem: clients struggle to tell what changed between design submissions.
offerings.deliverable: compare two model snapshots, inspect element/category changes, provide a change register and progress dashboard.
offerings.evidence: BIMSpect design-progress intelligence prototype, developed around IFC/viewer workflows in 2026.

offerings.title: Automated drawing, sheet and BIM reporting tools
offerings.problem: repetitive schedules, annotations, sheets, exports and model reports.
offerings.deliverable: scheduled drawing/report generation, door/window/room schedules, QA exports and documented naming conventions.
offerings.evidence: professional Dynamo and shop-drawing scripting; American Superblock's experimental drawing, schedule and specification workspaces. Outputs must be checked against office and project standards.

offerings.title: BIM data extraction and integration
